size.description: Bytes as a number, a string such as "24MB" / "512KB" (1024-based), or null for unlimited.

count.description: Non-negative integer, or null for unlimited.

maxImages.description: Maximum images kept in one request. Default 8.

maxImagesPerMessage.description: Maximum images kept in one message. Default unlimited.

maxImageBytes.description: Maximum total base64 bytes of kept images. Default 16MB.

maxRequestBytes.description: Maximum estimated request body size. Default 24MB.

protectRecent.description: Newest N images are never removed by budgets. Default 2.

lowWatermark.description: Evict down to limit x this ratio. Default 0.75.

dedupe.description: Replace earlier byte-identical images. Default true.

payloadGuard.description: Scrub the provider payload if it still exceeds maxRequestBytes. Default true.

autoRecover.description: After HTTP 413, lower the limit and retry automatically. Default true.

initialOverheadBytes.description: Assumed non-message request size before the first measurement. Default 512KB.

showStatus.description: Show kept/total images in the footer when images are omitted. Default true.

models.description: Per-model overrides keyed by provider/modelId glob, e.g. "my-gateway/*".
